scope: Text-only editorial pass on current locked narration and exact LinkedIn post. No rendered-film, audio-performance, timing or delivery judgment.

metrics.hook: A pollock model can change what an AI's apparent advantage means.

editorial_checks.finding: Publication date, named fishery, affiliation and simulation mechanism match c1,c2,c3,c5,c6,c7,c8. Affiliation does not become a claim that all researchers reside in Alaska. Dates are correctly ordinal on both surfaces.

Researchers build and compare; the learned agent adjusts from simulated feedback; NOAA Fisheries and the North Pacific Fishery Management Council manage the real fishery. Neither text implies autonomous boats, deployed quota setting, or stakeholder endorsement.

The constant case couples higher spawning biomass with large annual catch swings. The separate stock-linked case couples higher catches with lower spawning biomass relative to its own comparison. No biomass advantage is generalized across cases and no smoother-policy response becomes catch stability.

Narration explains recruitment through young fish entering the stock and defines spawning biomass as the weight of breeding fish. The post supplies the same biomass definition and short paragraphs. Proper names are long but necessary and accurately retained.

The narration phrase simulations with public code matches c17 and public_code_validation.json. It asserts availability only; it does not claim reproduced results, complete reproducibility, an open-source license or the exact settings behind published plots. The post may omit this additional supporting fact.

May offer no management advantage is explicitly a possibility, not a reported negative result. Recommending identical goals is an editorial next-step argument. Neither text claims profit, household income improvement, bycatch benefit, operational superiority or adoption.

Both land on alternatives worth investigating against explicit catch and breeding-stock goals, with no demonstrated winning real-world rule. Both close with a genuine question about the balance; neither contradicts the locked earned-curiosity angle.

nonblocking_observation: The post hook remains somewhat abstract, as the existing7.8hook axis already records. It does not overpromise and does not require revision.
